gates.route: BDD replacement of the complete single-orbit minimal-negative-clause table
gates.argument: For a downward-closed Boolean family, all minimal forbidden subsets give its prime all-negative CNF. A fixed1 set is inconsistent iff it contains such a subset; a variable is forced0 iff adding it contains one. Unit propagation therefore enforces domain consistency. A BDD can change size or branching, but does not strengthen these local primary-variable inferences.
